subject: Genetics
title: Epigenetic Inheritance in Worms
description: A short lesson to help you apply Epigenetic Inheritance in Worms.

hook.text: C. elegans worms pass epigenetic changes for up to 14 generations. In worms at least, acquired traits clearly transmit.

buildup.text: Scientists triggered gene silencing using RNA interference in one generation of worms.

discovery.text: The silencing persisted for over a dozen generations without the original trigger.

twist.text: Small RNAs carry the signal. They amplify themselves each generation, maintaining the silencing.

punchline.text: Fourteen generations remembered what the first one learned.

quiz.question: How many generations can epigenetic changes persist in C. elegans?
